hook: 3 ways to get fewer “where is my order?” emails

tips.title: Set a shipping limit
tips.body: Decide how many days an order can sit unshipped before you look at it.

tips.title: Answer with the facts
tips.body: Put the delivery status, the estimated date and the tracking link in your first reply.

tips.title: Write first
tips.body: If the carrier reports a delay, tell the customer before they ask.
